items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs NO due to hamstring; had been doubtful after limited Friday return.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy collapses to crumbs; Andrews/Bateman target bump
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman WR1 role; Mark Andrews elevated share

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT for Sunday vs CIN with hamstring injury suffered in Wednesday practice; missed Thu/Fri practices.
items.why: Hamstring; history of multi-game absences on similar injury
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU WR/TE volume redistributes
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel; Schultz TE stream uptick

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs NE with foot injury.
items.why: Foot; LP-DNP-DNP practice trend noted by Levitan
items.implication: PIT WR volume to Metcalf/others; remove Pittman

items.text: Puka Nacua officially QUESTIONABLE for MNF vs NYG (hip); no practice Sat. McVay noted additional groin soreness after Thu practice, unrelated to camp issues; likely pregame decision.
items.implication: Have Monday pivot ready; start if active but risk GTD
items.opportunity: If OUT: Atwell/Mooney/Whittington or Fields volume

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE but expected to play; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson. Earlier reports had him good to go after full practice.
items.why: Back; coach/player comments positive, full Fri work
items.implication: Start Burrow with normal confidence; CIN pass game intact

items.text: Brock Bowers listed DOUBTFUL; Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from PS. Will test knee pregame.
items.why: Knee/meniscus recovery; limited Friday return after missing early week
items.implication: Plan without Bowers; Mayer primary beneficiary if inactive

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Limited Friday practice, listed Q, 4pm ET game.
items.why: Ribs from Week 1; missed early practices, limited Fri
items.implication: Monitor closely; Herbert/LAC pass game projections swing hard if OUT
items.opportunity: If OUT: Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris target bump

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for 2026 debut. Patriots desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR); potential for 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Cleared; team needs explosives; matchup/schedule window
items.implication: Flex/ upside RB play; monitor split with Stevenson
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential; goal-line/receiving upside in NE offense

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN. Combined with Etienne Week 1 reduced workload, creates committee squeeze risk.
items.implication: Etienne downgrade; Kamara reclaims passing-down/third-down role
items.opportunity: Kamara volume return; Etienne/Miller split early downs

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status still matters for full monopoly.
items.why: Week 1 usage data + potential Black absence
items.implication: CMC elite volume floor even higher if Black limited/out

items.text: Kenneth Walker on Week 2 LOVE: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), targeted on 40% of routes (tied team lead). IND just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: Start with confidence; RB1 upside range

items.text: Ashton Jeanty on LOVE: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan league lead), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Soft LAC matchup.
Bucky Irving on LOVE: 26% target share, every RB red-zone touch Week 1, out-routed Gainwell. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
Travis Etienne on HATE: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back further squeezes role. NO underdog script.
items.why: Reduced early-down role + Kamara return + game script
items.conflict: If Kamara limited, Etienne could rebound
